text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~...! How was that? I'm feeling 
pretty confident about that run!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, it's our secret weapon 
that Trainer and I have honed together!

From where I stand, you've still got a 
long way to go! Let us polish you up some 
more, little lamb.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
So mean! Stop calling me a lost little 
lamb already!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I'll blow everyone away! Alright 
then, let's do one more lap!!"

Listen well. Even when your body reaches 
its limit, do not let your spirit break.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Y... Yes!

"There is no need to give in to negativity 
just because you hit a wall. Grow 
stronger! So that you can run again 
tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...Stronger! So strong that my... that our 
running... leaves an indelible mark on 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Whew... *pant*... I've gotten to the point 
where I can handle this much~

Yeah, bringing you into the racing world 
really was the right choice after all.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much... for finding me— and 
for always watching over me."

Fufu... Well, you had a look on your face 
like you really wanted to run. I figured 
you must really love running.

"Let us keep running together. I shall 
always be watching over you by your side, 
Siam-chan—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved great results in the SWBC, 
the Grand Masters was finally drawing 
near.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I originally used the simulator to make 
up for my lack of knowledge, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The interactions with the Three Goddesses, 
the exchange of history left behind by the 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcending time, they have left so much 
behind for the Umamusume running in the 
present.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The ultimate AI designed to support 
Umamusume and Trainers, the 'Mega Dream 
Supporter.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Aside from their vast knowledge, the 
Triple Goddesses taught us what is truly 
important for a Trainer to keep running 
alongside an Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I want to show the Three 
Goddesses at the Grand Masters—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want the Three Goddesses who raised us 
to see just how much we've grown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, the name of the Goddess 
who possesses the knowledge I need most 
right now is—"

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here. The sun has—yes, it seems 
it's reached its zenith.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: —Well then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should we do? What do you 
guys want to do?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, as if that hasn't already been 
decided.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will respect your wishes. And in 
turn—your vivid individuality.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
As you know, a possibility that has once 
died out can never be brought back to 
life.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"Individuality, once lost, vanishes into 
the darkness."

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: So, we just need to keep connecting them.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
You will carry it forward and pass it on. 
Your individuality belongs solely to you. 
And it is what you shall entrust to future 
generations.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
With you serving as a bridge, I am sure a 
colorful future awaits us from here on 
out.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Now, reach out your hand. —The future has 
only just begun.
Acquired "<itemname>".

The wisdom bestowed by the Three 
Goddesses—at the Grand Masters, I'll prove 
that I've truly taken their feelings to 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: The wind has foretold your arrival.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us go. To the source of the wind. 
To the place of origins—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: —This is where the wind is born.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
There were so many wonderful wishes and 
feelings that led up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: A wish to watch over them from far away.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
A wish for people to live in good health, 
no matter the place, no matter the era.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: And now, I am making a wish.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill everyone's wishes, my desire to 
watch over them, and deliver on this 
wonderful wish—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to never forget that there 
were so many out there wishing for your 
happiness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Godolphin Barb's words, I nodded 
along with my trainee.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Blessings upon your existence. May eternal 
happiness be yours...—

Goddesses—at the Grand Masters, I'll prove 
that I've truly taken their feelings to 
heart!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I can hear the sound of hoofbeats 
galloping across the turf.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
—Let us go. To the place where all things 
take root.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
—Since time immemorial, the race known as 
Umamusume has possessed the instinct to 
"run."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: And still, we continue to run.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: What supports this instinct? That is—

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
—It's strength. Not merely brute physical 
power, nor just the steadfastness of 
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Through layers upon layers of history, we 
Umamusume have attained true strength.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: By inheriting and carrying it on.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"As long as your strength remains 
unshakeable, lasting glory will surely be 
promised to you."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: Here, take it.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: —With every last ounce of my strength.
